paper_id: CodeRL+_ Improving Code Generation via Reinforcement with Execution Semantics Alignment
title: CODERL+: Improving Code Generation via Reinforcement with Execution Semantics Alignment
motivation: LLMs learn code through textual patterns but code correctness depends on execution semantics; RLVR's sparse pass/fail signals are insufficient
problem_framing: Semantic gap between textual code representation and formal execution semantics limits code generation quality
key_insight: Jointly optimize code generation with execution semantics alignment by inferring variable-level execution trajectories from failed rollouts
method_signature: Dual-objective RLVR: code generation + execution semantics alignment via variable final-value prediction
evaluation_criteria: pass@1 on HumanEval/LeetCode/LiveCodeBench; accuracy on code reasoning and test output generation
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Execution semantics alignment incurs additional computational overhead compared to standard RL algorithms
evidence_for_taste: fails to effectively bridge the semantic gap
thinking_moves: 识别RLVR仅用最终执行结果的稀疏信号不足，需要中间执行状态
将代码生成与执行语义理解建模为双向关系：合成状态转换函数 vs 理解状态转换函数
失败样本比成功样本更能揭示模型对执行语义的误解
用探针实验验证内部表征是否对齐执行语义，而非仅依赖行为指标
